title: Jewellery E-Commerce Platform
description: Built for a friend's mother's independent jewellery business after she hit a wall trying to customise her existing store on the template platform she was on (Wix/Shopify-class), locking custom code and real payment integrations behind paid tiers she couldn't justify for a small operation. Rebuilt from the ground up as a headless storefront she can fully run herself: catalogue, pricing, and content all editable without touching code, with a checkout flow that doesn't lock her into one costly payment provider.
features: Headless CMS architecture (Payload 3 + MongoDB) driving the full catalogue products, categories, materials, and curated sets, all editable by a non-technical owner with zero code changes.

Dual checkout flow: manual bank transfer with auto-generated payment instructions and QR codes emailed to the customer, or card payment through a local payment gateway with a transparent processing fee so she isn't forced into one payment method.
Server-side order integrity: totals are recalculated from source data in a beforeChange hook rather than trusted from the client, closing off price manipulation at checkout.

CMS-driven page builder (hero sliders, brand story, editorial/social galleries, FAQ, policy pages) so marketing content can evolve without developer involvement, backed by Playwright E2E and Vitest integration tests.

logs.event: Brought in informally to help customise an existing store on a template platform, editing directly through the platform's own site builder. Hit a hard wall when free-tier limits blocked custom code and real payment integration.

Started building a custom storefront from scratch in the only time available, roughly two-week windows between semesters. Got a bare-bones HTML/CSS/JS store working, then set it aside for a stretch with no steady time to push it further.
Decided with the client to abandon the original build and rebuild on a proper headless architecture instead.
Started the rebuild — Next.js frontend on a Payload CMS backend, planned around a free-tier hosting setup (same model used for FinanceOS and this portfolio).
Built out the full catalogue, dual checkout flow (bank transfer or gateway payment), CMS-driven page builder, and test coverage (Playwright + Vitest) to a working prototype.

Client feedback cycle each round of requested changes meant restructuring already-built features. Paused with the project roughly 70-75% complete; picking back up once there's a longer uninterrupted stretch available.
